verdict.rationale: Headless or programmatic automation is a fair question for a SaaS commerce product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no way to run Shopify POS itself headlessly or in CI. Shopify POS is described as an iOS/Android app for in-person selling. Shopify CLI is documented only for scaffolding POS UI extensions, and Admin API access is offered from inside extensions; both are developer building blocks, not headless operation of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
